manifest_row.title: Endangered and Threatened Species: Reclassification of the Humpback Chub from Endangered to Threatened with a Section 4(d) Rule

screening.main_topic: A proposed U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service rule to reclassify the humpback chub from endangered to threatened and establish conservation provisions.
screening.climate_relevance: The document discusses climate change as a factor affecting river flows and water temperatures in the Colorado River basin, including projections of reduced warm-season runoff, more frequent or severe drought, and potential effects on humpback chub habitat and nonnative predators.
screening.reason: The text is principally a detailed species-status assessment and proposed wildlife rule, not climate coverage. Climate change nevertheless appears in substantive analysis of future hydrological conditions and species threats, making it relevant as background discourse.
